t: What he said stepping into the mosque
a: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
p: Aʿūdhu bi-Llāhi-l-ʿaẓīm, wa bi-wajhihi-l-karīm, wa sulṭānihi-l-qadīm, mina-sh-shayṭāni-r-rajīm
m: I seek refuge in Allah the Magnificent, and in His noble face, and in His eternal authority, from the rejected Satan.
